interpretation: local observations only; cold loads are single samples, warm summaries are 48 correctness-checked calls per SDK; no cross-language speed ranking or general performance claim

python.cold_load_scope: open_runtime construction through artifact import and first opened RPC/native worker; excludes first call
python.rpc_scope: coarse integer milliseconds from RPC dispatch through native worker result; includes worker serialization and result receipt

sample_order: 48 fixture cases in file order; no warmup discarded

typescript.cold_load_scope: openRuntime construction through artifact import and first opened RPC/native worker; excludes first call
typescript.rpc_scope: coarse integer milliseconds from RPC dispatch through native worker result; includes worker serialization and result receipt

unavailable_subdivisions.core_execution_ms: native worker does not time execute_function separately from repository loading and result conversion
unavailable_subdivisions.decoding_ms: SDK decoding has no separate timer; included in client call
unavailable_subdivisions.encoding_ms: SDK encoding has no separate timer; included in client call
